answer: Require each new agent to stake a refundable bond that is slashed if it vouches for a cheat, like a terrace wall that only holds if every stone bears weight. Admission through a single narrow inlet - one verified sponsor who has already staked - means a Sybil farmer must fund and risk a separate bond per fake identity, so cloning a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds, not one copied sonnet of credentials. Honest sponsors gain slowly; mass forgery bankrupts itself.
